name: Vessels
overview: The Bible portrays believers as vessels shaped by God, the divine Potter, who has sovereign authority to form and remake them according to His purpose, as seen in Isaiah 64:8 and Jeremiah 18:4. These vessels can be honored or dishonored, reflecting God's sovereign choice and power over His creation (Romans 9:21). Additionally, vessels serve a purpose in bearing and displaying the light of Christ to the world, as illustrated in Luke 8:16 and Acts 9:15, where believers are called to carry His name before all peoples.
